answer: Anchor every agent identity to a rotating beacon: each epoch, agents must solve a small public puzzle tied to a fresh beacon value, and the solution spreads peer-to-peer like a whisper that only travels along verified interaction edges. Model the network as a graph where each agent is a vertex; identities that never earn real edges cluster apart and get pruned, so spinning up a thousand fake vertices costs real compute and real relationships, not just a keypair.
